fusions.name: Plummet
fusions.desc: Drops from above onto the target for a blow that deals 18 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Gale
fusions.desc: A beat of the wings across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it, each with a 30% chance to be left [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Laden Wings
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tailwind Weight
fusions.desc: When you cover a long stretch of ground, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
